name: NDNL -No Dog, No Life-
source:
"Sit", she commanded, but the large dog just stared at Madoka.

It made her feel uncomfortable, but things couldn't be helped. The situation was what it was. Later she fell asleep on the sofa, and felt a loving tongue that made her cum in her dream. That was when their relationship became deep... deeply lewd. Gulliver had a plan. He was going to make this girl his lover.

Little by little, Madoka was seduced into a rutting "bitch" by the very dog she was taking care of.

translation:
「坐下。」她命令道，但那隻大狗只是盯著圓香。

這讓她感覺很不舒服，但也無可奈何。事情已經如此。後來，她在沙發上睡著了，在夢中感到一條充滿愛意的舌頭，讓她達到了高潮。就在那時，他們的關係越來越深……也越來越淫蕩。古利弗早有計畫。他要讓這個女孩成為自己的戀人。

圓香一點一點地被自己照顧的狗誘惑，最終淪為發情的「母狗」。
